subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Crisp
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. '**Tender**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the **meanings** of the **given word** and **marked option**:

 
 
• ​**Crisp- **used to describe cooked foods, that are well cooked so that they are just dry and hard enough.
 
• Tender- used to describe meat or vegetables easy to cut or chew.
 
 
 
• Let's look at the **meanings** of the other** given options**:
 
 
• **​****Hard**- not easy to bend, cut, or break.
 
• **Fresh**- used to describe food or flowers that are recently picked, made, or cooked.
 
• **Rotten**- to undergo decomposition from the action of bacteria or fungi; to go to ruin.
 
 
 
• Hence from the given meanings, we find that ‘Crisp’ and ‘Tender’ are antonyms.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 4.

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the synonyms and antonyms for the given word 'Crisp':

 
• Synonyms: firm, crunchy, crumbly, fresh, brittle, unwilted, dry, hard.
 
• Antonyms: soft, limp, mild, shabby, nasty, foul.
